el_per_grade.label: EL per Grade
el_per_grade.note: The core disparity dial. Raise it to make grade gaps harsher.

enemy_ac_base.label: Enemy AC Base
enemy_ac_base.note: Benchmark enemy AC = this + its EL.

enemy_attack_base.label: Enemy Attack Base
enemy_attack_base.note: Benchmark enemy attack = this + its EL.

enemy_hp_per_el.label: Enemy HP per EL
enemy_hp_per_el.note: Standard enemy HP = (Base + this x EL) x its RGM. Retuned from 3 to 4 after simulating 3-action turns, where a PC makes two Strikes per round.

xp_coefficient.label: XP Coefficient
xp_coefficient.note: XP to next rank = this x EL^2.

class_primary_gain_grade.label: REFERENCE — Class Primary Gain / Grade
class_primary_gain_grade.note: Ability points to the class primary at each grade-up.

class_secondary_gain_grade.label: REFERENCE — Class Secondary Gain / Grade
class_secondary_gain_grade.note: Ability points to the class secondary at each grade-up.

profession_gain_grade.label: REFERENCE — Profession Gain / Grade
profession_gain_grade.note: Points to each of the profession's two abilities per grade.

race_gain_grade.label: REFERENCE — Race Gain / Grade
race_gain_grade.note: Points to each racial signature ability per grade above F.

base_ability_score.label: REFERENCE — Base Ability Score
base_ability_score.note: Starting value before any race, class or profession input.

grade_price_multiplier.label: Grade Price Multiplier
grade_price_multiplier.note: Cost and income multiply by this per grade index. A longsword is 15 gp at F, 45 gp at E, 135 gp at D. Set to 3 because 3^6 = 729, which fits inside the 1,000x span from 1 cp to 1 pp — so standard coinage covers all seven grades. At 4 or 5 the coins break and you would need new denominations.

max_track_divergence_el.label: Max Track Divergence (EL)
max_track_divergence_el.note: Combat EL and Craft EL may not differ by more than this. 10 = two grades. Set high to allow free specialisation; set to 5 to force the tracks to move together.

grade_compensation.label: Grade Compensation
grade_compensation.note: Added to every DC and enemy stat per grade index. Tested at 1.5 and 2.5 against real characters built from the sheet with the Acquisitions proficiency schedule: 2 holds a Standard fight at 0.02-0.49 drops and 99-100% win across all seven grades. DO NOT set to 0.

challenges_per_rank.label: Challenges per Rank
challenges_per_rank.note: The master pacing dial. 8 gives 40 challenges per grade, an 8-13 session chapter. Lower for brisk play, higher for a long campaign.

grade_escalation_factor.label: Grade Escalation Factor
grade_escalation_factor.note: Multiplies challenges-per-rank by this to the power of grade index. 1.0 = constant pacing (recommended). 1.15 makes S-grade ranks take 2.3x as many challenges as F-grade.

discovery_weight.label: Discovery Weight
discovery_weight.note: A discovery is worth this many challenges before the 2x2 split routes it. Above 1 because exploration is the premise of the game.

enemy_hp_base.label: Enemy HP Base
enemy_hp_base.note: Flat HP added before the per-EL term, so low-grade foes are not one-shot.

enemy_damage_per_el.label: Enemy Damage per EL
enemy_damage_per_el.note: Standard enemy damage per round = this x EL x its RGM. Raised from 2 to 3 after simulation: at 2 a Standard encounter downed 0.07 PCs and the party won 100% of the time.

weapon_die_average.label: Weapon Die Average
weapon_die_average.note: Fallback weapon average if none is selected. d8 = 4.5.

ambient_divisor.label: Ambient Divisor
ambient_divisor.note: Ambient damage per watch = Region EL x Region RGM / this, x (grade gap - 1). Lower it to make over-grade regions crueller.

track_spillover.label: REFERENCE — Track Spillover
track_spillover.note: When a track cannot accept XP — at the divergence cap, or already at EL 35 — the award goes to the OTHER track at this rate. Without it a party that only ever fights freezes permanently at Combat EL 11. With it they reach both maxima in 287 sessions against 186 for balanced play.
